import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    // Edge class
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
        }
        long rem() { return cap - flow; }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 8200;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges;
    static long[] dist;
    static long[] potential;
    static long[] capacity;
    static int[] pre;
    static boolean[] inQueue;
    static long maxFlow;
    static long minCost;
    static int nodes;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        adj[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        adj[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
        maxFlow = 0;
        minCost = 0;

        // SPFA for initial potentials
        Arrays.fill(potential, INF);
        potential[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        inQueue[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                Edge f = edges.get(idx);
                if (f.rem() > 0 && potential[f.v] > potential[u] + f.cost) {
                    potential[f.v] = potential[u] + f.cost;
                    if (!inQueue[f.v]) {
                        q.add(f.v);
                        inQueue[f.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Main loop: Dijkstra with reduced costs
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
            dist[s] = 0;
            capacity[s] = INF;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.add(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int u = (int) cur[1];
                if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge f = edges.get(idx);
                    long reduced = f.cost + potential[u] - potential[f.v];
                    if (f.rem() > 0 && dist[f.v] > dist[u] + reduced) {
                        dist[f.v] = dist[u] + reduced;
                        pre[f.v] = idx;
                        capacity[f.v] = Math.min(capacity[u], f.rem());
                        pq.add(new long[]{dist[f.v], f.v});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] == -1) break;

            // Update potentials
            for (int v = 0; v < nodes; ++v) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) potential[v] += dist[v];
            }

            long push = capacity[t];
            maxFlow += push;
            minCost += push * potential[t];

            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                Edge f = edges.get(pre[v]);
                v = edges.get(pre[v]).u;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        // Initialize global structures
        adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        edges = new ArrayList<>();
        dist = new long[MAXN];
        potential = new long[MAXN];
        capacity = new long[MAXN];
        pre = new int[MAXN];
        inQueue = new boolean[MAXN];

        // Source -> initial vertices
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            addEdge(0, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        // Roads
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < 105; ++t) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 51; ++j) {
                    long cost = c + (long) d * (2 * j + 1);
                    addEdge(t * n + x + 1, (t + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, cost);
                    addEdge(t * n + y + 1, (t + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        // Stay in place edges
        for (int t = 0; t < 105; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                addEdge(t * n + j + 1, (t + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
            }
        }

        // To sink from vertex 0
        for (int t = 0; t < 105; ++t) {
            addEdge(t * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
        }

        nodes = 6 + 107 * n;
        minCostMaxFlow(0, 105 * n + 1);
        System.out.println(minCost);
    }
}
